confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listings or booking pages checked. Accommodation is least certain given July low-season variation; cocktail and wine partly follow the local beer price relationship. THB examples assume about 33 THB per USD. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA and could not be independently confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Thailand's other beach-resort destinations such as Krabi and Koh Samui, adjusted for Phuket's tourist-area price level; hotel and hostel figures reflect July low-season rates.

anchor_basis.beer: Singha or Chang draft beer at a casual restaurant, about 120 THB
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at an independent cafe, about 100 THB
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: pad kra pao with fried egg plus a soft drink at a local restaurant, about 150 THB
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: two starters, two mains and one shared dessert with service and VAT at a mid-range restaurant, about 1,800 THB for two
anchor_basis.cocktail: gin and tonic or mojito at a tourist-area bar, about 280 THB
anchor_basis.wine_glass: glass of house red at a mid-range restaurant, about 300 THB
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: dorm bed in a registered Patong or Phuket Town hostel, about 400 THB in July
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a registered hostel, about 800 THB in July
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic fan or air-con guesthouse double room, about 700 THB in July
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: registered three-star hotel double in Patong or Kata, July low season, about 2,200 THB
